title: prop-types removal causes the slider to give errors
body:
preact-rheostat (at least the version used in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/5ec4609a8b99bf85a2b7b3ceab70bc27a01e6f6c) requires prop-types itself.

Our build step should have taken the usages of prop-types out of node_modules too, not just our own code.

This is why we unpublished 3.5.0
